name: Captain America Elevator Fight
look: Three film stills stacked vertically from Captain America: The Winter Soldier. Top: Chris Evans as Steve Rogers stands in a crowded elevator among stern men in dark clothes. Middle: a bald man in glasses and a suit faces him. Bottom: the men all grab and pile onto him at once.
use: Someone makes a statement or asks a question in a tense room, and everyone else turns on him at once. The top panel gets the setup line, the middle an optional reaction, and the bottom labels the group attacking.
slots: top panel: what Captain America says to the room
bottom panel: the group that turns on him
examples: I think pineapple belongs on pizza
Everyone who only ordered a salad
describe: superhero in an elevator full of guys who all attack him
chris evans gets jumped in an elevator
men in an elevator all grab one guy at once
winter soldier elevator fight scene in three panels
guy says something and everyone in the elevator piles on him
origin: The elevator fight from Captain America: The Winter Soldier (2014), where Steve Rogers is ambushed by the agents riding with him.
